svg.text: Option (in memory): valine-derived propionyl-CoA made and used inside the matrix; isoleucine-derived propionyl-CoA leaves as propanoate from the cytosol
BCKDH rule in the cytosol; YALI0 tags
Arrows: blue = carries flux in this minimum-total-flux solution (xMAINTENANCE lower bound 0); grey = 0. TargetP-2.0 values are predictions (mTP = mitochondrial transit peptide).
Not drawn: TCA cycle, the methylmalonyl route R2074-R2076 (blocked in all variants), R2140-R2142, isoleucine import and transamination, FAD and NAD recycling.
